title: OFF SHFT Logo Hat
descriptionHtml:
The O in OFF is a clock. The hands say 5:00.

Quitting time. The shift is done and the rest of the day is yours.

That's the whole idea, on the front of a hat. Wear it on the water, on the course, at the cottage or out by the boards.

Made to order and shipped to you.

Details

  • Front: the OFF SHFT logo, embroidered, about 63 mm (2.5 in) wide
  • Styles: Retro Trucker, 5-Panel, Dad Hat or Rope Cap
  • Retro Trucker: structured six-panel cap. Hard buckram front, mesh back, pre-curved visor, adjustable plastic snap closure
  • 5-Panel: structured mid-profile cap. One-piece front with no centre seam, 65% polyester and 35% cotton twill, adjustable plastic snap closure
  • Ships: made to order, usually ships in 2–5 business days

Fit questions? See Size & fit.
seoDescription: The O in OFF is a clock set to 5:00. Quitting time. The OFF SHFT logo, embroidered on a hat made to order.

styleNotes.Retro Trucker: Structured six-panel cap with a hard buckram front, mesh back and adjustable plastic snap closure.
styleNotes.5-Panel: Structured mid-profile cap in 65% polyester, 35% cotton twill, with a one-piece front (no centre seam) and an adjustable plastic snap closure.

toConfirm: It isn't confirmed that Printful keeps the logo 5.2 mm right of centre on six-panel fronts, so the front seam falls between OFF and SHFT. That's the Retro Trucker, and the Dad Hat if its build is six-panel.
The Retro Trucker's fabric is left out: Printful's page says 26% cotton, 74% polyester, but the maker is changing the blend from 65/35, so stock may be mixed.

The Dad Hat's and Rope Cap's material, panels, profile and closure aren't in the research yet. They come from Printful's spec sheets. The Dad Hat's style note no longer says six-panel: only notes.md's general rule counts dad hats as six-panel, so confirm the 6245CM's build before the seam rule is applied to it.
The Rope Cap's front embroidery area wasn't found, nor whether its front has a centre seam.
The embroidery on the Rope Cap needs a sample check: Printful reviews mention wrinkling and stitches through the lining.
Care instructions for each hat style aren't confirmed yet.
Thread colours aren't set yet. They follow the fabric colours, once those are picked and a sew-out on the real blank passes.

title: Punched Out. Jacket
descriptionHtml:
Punched out.

Two words and a full stop, small on the chest. Nothing else to say.

The shift is done. This one says so without making a big deal of it.

For the dock when the wind picks up.

Made to order and shipped to you.

Details

  • Left chest: PUNCHED OUT., embroidered small
  • Packable anorak: a half-zip pullover with an adjustable bungee hood
  • Fabric: 2.8 oz polyester micro poplin, wind and rain resistant
  • Packs into its front pouch pocket
  • Left sleeve: the jacket maker's own logo

Which size? See Size & fit.
